info.title: Pythontopia Client-Facing API
info.description:
Curated, hand-authored OpenAPI 3.0.3 description of the **client-facing** REST surface of the Pythontopia backend (Spring Boot, Java 21).

This spec is intended for native clients (Windows .NET, Android, WeChat mini-program) to use for code generation and reference. It is a *subset* of the full backend surface (teacher dashboards, RAG/media generation, intent/bug-mine internals are intentionally omitted). For the exhaustive, always-up-to-date spec, regenerate from the live springdoc endpoint (`GET /v3/api-docs`) as documented in `openapi/README.md`.

## Conventions
- **Base URL / prefix**: REST endpoints live under `/api` (e.g. `/api/auth/login`); there is no servlet context path. `/healthz` sits at the root.
- **Auth**: Bearer JWT (HS256), 12h TTL. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `POST /api/auth/refresh` re-issues a token from a still-valid token (it does not consume a separate refresh token). On `401`, re-login via `POST /api/auth/login`.
- **Public endpoints** (no JWT required): everything under `/api/auth/**` and `/api/course/**`, plus `GET /api/media/assets/{id}` and `GET /healthz`. All other operations require `bearerAuth`.
- **Error envelope**: every non-2xx JSON response uses the shape `{ code, message, details[], traceId, timestamp }` (see `ApiError`).
- **Numbers**: `integer/int64` = Java Long, `integer/int32` = int/Integer, `number` (no format) = BigDecimal, `number/double` = Double.
- **Arbitrary JSON**: fields typed as `JsonNode` are server-side Jackson nodes and may be any JSON value (object, array, or scalar).
- **SSE**: streaming endpoints respond with `text/event-stream`; named events are `plan`, `trace`, `token`, `result`, and `error`.

servers.description: Local backend (desktop / WeChat devtools via host loopback)

tags.name: world
tags.description: Pixel-town world state: session, player, calendar, saves, skills, NPCs

tags.name: learner
tags.description: Learner profile, mastery, recommendations, path, evaluations

tags.name: practice
tags.description: Public problem view and code submissions / judging

tags.name: classroom

post.summary: Re-issue a JWT from a still-valid token
post.description: Accepts a currently valid (non-expired) JWT and returns a fresh token with a new 12h expiry. This is not a separate opaque refresh token; once a token has expired, the client must log in again.

post.summary: Aggregated bootstrap payload for entering the town
post.description: Returns world, player, profile, quests, mastery, learning path, skills, NPC states, the active save slot, and pending calendar events in one call. Invoked on login and after each chapter reset.

get.summary: Get or create the current world session

patch.summary: Update player tile position and facing direction

post.summary: Advance the in-game world by one day
post.description: Increments dayIndex, rotates weekday/season/weather, decays mastery, nudges emotion-persistence, and schedules calendar events for the new day.

200.description: New world snapshot plus any newly scheduled events

post.summary: Persist a JSON snapshot into a save slot
post.description: The request body is a raw JSON string (the serialized client snapshot). It is stored verbatim against the slot.

get.summary: List skill-tree nodes and the caller's unlocked skills
List all NPC dialog states for the caller
Get (or initialize) one NPC's dialog state

post.summary: Advance an NPC dialog state machine

get.summary: Get the current in-game calendar state

post.summary: Request a boss (arena) problem for a chapter/stage
Submit a boss attempt for server-side evaluation
post.description: The body's `chapter` must match the path `chapter`. On graph-evaluation failure the client may fall back to local Pyodide.

204.description: No profile has been created yet

put.description: Students may only write the subjective self-editable dimensions; teachers/admins may write any of their own 8 dimensions. The request must contain at least one of scoreDelta / evidenceIncrement / tagsAdd / metadata.

get.summary: List KC mastery snapshots for the caller
Get a learning path by id

post.summary: Complete a quest with optional evidence

get.summary: Get the active course pack summary
List knowledge components, optionally by chapter
List course pages for a KC
List course problems, optionally by KC
List course videos, optionally by chapter

200.description: Video manifest entries (may be empty when no task-point videos exist)

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional byte range, e.g. `bytes=0-`. Triggers a 206 partial response.

get.summary: Stream a course video (supports HTTP Range)
get.description: Returns `video/mp4`. With a `Range` header the response is `206 Partial Content` with `Content-Range`; without it, `200 OK` with the full body. `Accept-Ranges: bytes` is always advertised.

404.description: Video not found or file missing

get.summary: Render a course page as a PNG image
get.description: Renders the corresponding source PDF page to PNG (cached server-side) for inline evidence display.

404.description: Page not found or out of range
Document not found / out of range / missing on disk

get.summary: Get the public (student-safe) view of a problem

200.description: Created submission (judging may still be in progress)

get.summary: Get a submission with its judge result
List classrooms the caller belongs to

post.summary: Join a classroom by join code (student)

post.description: Streams the tutor's answer as Server-Sent Events. Response content type is `text/event-stream`. Named events: `plan`, `trace`, `token`, `result`, `error`. Each event's `data:` line carries a JSON payload.
Proxies one orchestrator turn to the Python graph service and streams results as SSE (`text/event-stream`). Named events: `plan`, `trace`, `token`, `result`, `error`.
Streams resource generation progress as SSE (`text/event-stream`). Named events: `plan`, `trace`, `token`, `result`, `error`.
Streams a profile-interview turn as SSE (`text/event-stream`). Named events: `plan`, `trace`, `token`, `result`, `error`.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional byte range; triggers a 206 partial response.

get.description: Serves generated media bytes by id (for use as `` / `

404.description: Asset not found or file missing

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT, 12h TTL. Obtain via /api/auth/login; renew (while still valid) via /api/auth/refresh.

BadRequest.description: Validation or malformed request (codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, BAD_REQUEST).

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid JWT (code: UNAUTHORIZED). Re-login required.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (codes: NOT_FOUND and resource-specific *_NOT_FOUND).

JsonNode.description: Arbitrary JSON value (object, array, or scalar). Backed by a Jackson JsonNode on the server.

ApiError.description: Standard error envelope returned for all non-2xx JSON responses.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.

details.description: Optional field-level or contextual detail lines.

teacherInviteCode.description: Required to register as TEACHER (validated server-side).

nextNodeId.description: Node to advance to (null to stay).

effects.description: Side effects produced by this dialog turn.

SaveSlotCreateRequest.description: Only displayName is currently consumed server-side; the other fields are accepted to align with the client save payload shape.

difficulty.description: Desired difficulty 1-5; null lets the server infer from stage.

ProfileSignalsPayload.description: Learner profile signals used to tailor boss problems.

LearnerProfileDto.description: 8-dimension learner profile. Nested dimension objects mirror the JSONB sub-documents.

SelfDimensionRequest.description: Self-assessment / direct-write for one dimension. Provide at least one of scoreDelta / evidenceIncrement / tagsAdd / metadata.

QuestCompleteRequest.description: Evidence payload when completing a quest. Required fields depend on the quest's requiredEvidenceType.

available.description: Whether the mp4 file is present and playable.

Verdict.description: AC=accepted, WA=wrong answer, RE=runtime error, TLE=time limit, CE=static-check fail, MLE=memory limit, SYSTEM_ERROR=judge error.

images.description: Optional base64 screenshots; max 3, each <= ~8MB string.

SseEvent.description: Raw Server-Sent Events stream. Each message has an `event:` name (one of plan, trace, token, result, error) and a `data:` line carrying a JSON payload. Codegen for this endpoint should treat the body as a raw stream rather than a typed object.
